where: crates/blaze-core effects Effect::Journal { dir: FileName }; bstd fs/journal.rs changes_since; blaze-cli journal_sweep.rs plan_units
what: when blaze starts in the checkout's root, the root is DirName::Root and changes_since refuses it (JournalError::Root), because the effect names a FileName, which is never empty. The sweep then makes one unit per large top-level folder, and every root-level row, every small folder's row and every served script row is statted on every request.
cost: the floor the brief asked for ('the files of the folders told') cannot be reached for tempo, nor for any checkout run from its root
cause: Effect::Journal took a FileName, not a DirName
whys: the journal was first written for a named folder under the root
class: an effect whose argument type cannot name a value the driver hands out (the root)
prevention: to do: Effect::Journal { dir: DirName } across blaze-core's drivers and its sim (another writer owns crates/blaze-core/src/sim), then plan_units gives [""] for the root too
annoyance: the sim is off limits to this lane, so the port waits
